nodes.name: Webhook
nodes.notes: The API's address: GET /webhook/olist-mock-api?source=payments|reviews&page=N&page_size=N. Answers through the 'Respond' node. The workflow must be published for the production URL to work.

nodes.name: Pick file
nodes.notes: Checks the source parameter and picks the matching Google Drive file ID. Paste the IDs of payments.json and reviews.json at the top of this node. An unknown source returns an error.

nodes.name: Download JSON from Drive
nodes.notes: Downloads the full JSON file for the requested source from Google Drive. Needs the Google Drive credential.

nodes.name: Parse JSON
nodes.notes: Reads the downloaded file as JSON, so the records can be paged.

nodes.name: Return one page
nodes.notes: Cuts out the requested page (default 20,000 records, max 50,000) and adds page, page_size, total_pages and total, like a real paginated API.

nodes.name: Respond
nodes.notes: Sends the page back to the caller as the HTTP response.
